WITH race_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    r.name as race_name,
    SUM(res.points) as total_points
  FROM results res
  JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY r.name
),
average_total AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_points) as avg_total_points
  FROM race_totals
),
above_average_races AS (
  SELECT 
    rt.race_name, 
    rt.total_points,
    rt.total_points - (SELECT avg_total_points FROM average_total) as excess
  FROM race_totals rt
  WHERE rt.total_points > (SELECT avg_total_points FROM average_total)
),
above_avg_laps AS (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(res.laps AS FLOAT)) as avg_laps
  FROM results res
  JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
  JOIN above_average_races aar ON r.name = aar.race_name
)
SELECT 
  SUM(total_points) as combined_total_points,
  (SELECT avg_laps FROM above_avg_laps) as average_laps_completed,
  AVG(excess) as average_excess_over_average
FROM above_average_races;
